note: Socorro County (NM) publishes no queryable zoning district service. The City of Socorro, the only municipality found zoning, publishes its zoning map only as a static 2018 PDF (Zoning-Map-2018.pdf). County zoning is directed to phone (575-835-0589); the county ordinances page and GIS portal link no zoning layer. ArcGIS searches for Socorro zoning and the county's Axiom-hosted services (nm.gis.axiomnh.com) returned only parcels, addresses and tax districts. Regrid has zoning fields but is a paid commercial dataset, not official.
